newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico Cetes rate soars on staggering peso.
newsitem.headline: Mexico Cetes rate soars on staggering peso.

text.p: Mexican overnight Cetes rates sharply entended early gains in late trade on Thursday to stand up 375 basis points to 22.00 percent.
Traders said the pricipal reason for the increase was in response to a speculative run on the peso.

Traders said the peso slide came amid market jitters in the wake of Wednesday's testimony by U.S. Federal Reserve Chairman Alan Greenspan, and the process whereby the U.S. government certifies Mexican participation in combatting the drug trade.

The central bank also helped jack up secondary rates, traders said, by injecting liquidity into the market, and at high interest rates, instead of draining cash as it had done for most of the year so far.
"The market was nervous enough to begin with over the peso, so when the central bank injected liquidity at such high rates, well, the market just went crazy," a dealer said.
